svg.title: P026. From five order lines to five category totals
svg.desc: Seven stages trace all input rows through both joins, category labels, line values, grouping and sorting. Gold marks focus rows, blue marks source values, and purple marks calculations. Drinks has one order, three units and a value of 28. Stationery has zero sales and value zero. The unmatched product has four units and a NULL value.
svg.text: From five order lines to five category totals
5 sale lines → 6 joined rows → 5 reporting groups

g.aria-label: Step 1. Start with the three input tables
g.text: Start with the three input tables
Follow line 1 through product 10 to category 1, Drinks.

g.aria-label: Step 2. Keep every sale line and look up its product
g.text: Keep every sale line and look up its product
LEFT JOIN on ProductID · 5 lines → 5 rows

g.aria-label: LEFT JOIN on ProductID · 5 lines → 5 rows

g.text: Line 5 keeps its four units even though product 999 has no catalogue match.

g.aria-label: Step 3. Bring in categories that had no sales
g.text: Bring in categories that had no sales
FULL OUTER JOIN on CategoryID · 5 rows → 6 rows

g.aria-label: FULL OUTER JOIN on CategoryID · 5 rows → 6 rows

g.text: No row filter is needed. All five sale lines survive, and Stationery adds a sixth row.

g.aria-label: Step 4. Choose the category name for each row
g.text: Choose the category name for each row
Label each row · 6 rows → 6 labeled rows

g.aria-label: Label each row · 6 rows → 6 labeled rows

g.text: Lines 4 and 5 both lack a category match. Only line 4 has a matched product.

g.aria-label: Step 5. Price each line while its quantity and price are together
g.text: Price each line while its quantity and price are together
Quantity × Sale_Price · 6 labeled rows → 6 line values

g.aria-label: Quantity × Sale_Price · 6 labeled rows → 6 line values

g.text: The two Drinks lines contribute 2 × 10 = 20 and 1 × 8 = 8.

g.aria-label: Step 6. Combine rows that belong to the same reporting group
g.text: Combine rows that belong to the same reporting group
Group by matched category ID and category_name · 6 rows → 5 groups

g.aria-label: Group by matched category ID and category_name · 6 rows → 5 groups

g.text: Count matched line IDs. Zero lines give Stationery a value of 0. Line 5 is a real sale with an unknown price.

g.aria-label: Step 7. Sort the five category totals
g.text: Highest value first · NULL last · category name A–Z for ties

g.aria-label: Highest value first · NULL last · category name A–Z for ties

g.text: The five order lines contain 2 + 1 + 1 + 3 + 4 = 11 units. The report also adds up to 11.
